p0.original: 第四章 学习与人类后天发展
p0.en: Chapter IV. Learning and human development

p1.en: Translator of this chapter: Zhang Sai

p3.original: 本章视频导读，请扫描二维码观看。
p3.en: Scan the QR code to watch the video introduction to this chapter.

p4.original: 说到学习，你会想到什么？读书、上课、做作业？甚至，头悬梁、锥刺股？心理学里所说的学习其实是一个更宽泛的概念，每当我们的行为受后天经历的影响而发生持久的改变时，学习就发生了。可以说，我们的大脑无时无刻不在学习。本章将介绍学习的一些最基本的概念和规律，适用于动物，也适用于人。
p4.en: Speaking of studies, what do you think? Reading, studying, doing homework? Even, head-strangling, cone-stabbing? Learning, as it is called in psychology, is a broader concept, and it happens whenever our behaviour is affected by the experience of the day after tomorrow and it changes in a lasting way. We can say that our brains learn from time to time. This chapter will describe some of the most basic concepts and patterns of learning that apply to animals as well as to humans.

p5.original: 这些学习规律的发现过程极富戏剧性，伴随着一种被称为“行为主义”的心理学流派的兴衰，贯穿了心理学百年来的发展。心理学里的几大“神兽”——巴甫洛夫的狗、桑代克的猫、斯金纳的鸽子，都会在本章隆重登场。条件反射（conditioning）作为学习的一种形式（确切地说，分为经典条件反射和操作性条件反射），将是本章中最频繁出现的一个词。
p5.en: The discovery of these patterns of learning is dramatic, accompanied by the rise and decline of a psychological school known as “activism”, which has evolved over the centuries. A few of the great "gods" in psychology - Pavlov's dog, Sandek's cat, Skinner's pigeons - will all be here in this chapter. The most frequent term in this chapter will be the condition reflection (specifically, classic and operational) as a form of learning.

p6.original: 由于条件反射的许多现象最初是在动物实验中被发现的，加之这个词本身让人产生的联想，你可能会认为条件反射只是大脑对于刺激的初级、自动的反应，而与人类所特有的一些复杂、高级的认知功能（例如，语言）的学习无关。几十年前，心理学家们也是这样认为的。然而，近年来，与条件反射有着相似内核的人工智能算法（强化学习）已经被广泛用于包括自然语言处理在内的各种认知任务，不断地刷新着我们对于这种基本的学习方式所能解决的认知问题的预期。
p6.en: Since many phenomena of condition reflection were initially found in animal experiments, and because the word itself gives rise to conjuncture, you may consider the condition reflection to be a primary, automatic reaction of the brain to irritation, not related to the learning of complex, advanced cognitive functions specific to humans (e.g. language). That was the opinion of psychologists decades ago. In recent years, however, artificial intelligence algorithms (enhanced learning) with a similar kernel of resonance have been widely used in cognitive tasks, including the handling of natural languages, constantly refreshing our expectations of the cognitive problems that can be addressed by this basic learning approach.

p7.original: 是的，这些学习规律是如此有用，可以用于我们生活的方方面面。书中列举的许多创新的应用方式，让作为心理学研究人员的译者本人也深受启发，惊叹不已。例如，运用学习规律可以减少癌症化疗带来的副作用，可以帮助人类与野生动物和谐共处。当然，如果你刚刚来到心理学的世界，你可能会惊喜地发现，学习规律可以用于帮助人们消除不适宜的恐惧（例如，恐高、创伤后应激障碍），帮助孩子养成良好的行为习惯，甚至帮助你自己成为你希望成为的样子。读完本章之后，发挥你的创造力来运用这些规律吧！
p7.en: Yes, these learning patterns are so useful that they can be applied to all aspects of our lives. Many of the innovative ways in which the book is applied have inspired and amazed the individual who is the translator of psychology. For example, the application of learning patterns can reduce the side effects of cancer chemotherapy and can help humans live in harmony with wildlife. Of course, if you just come to the psychological world, you may find it surprising that learning patterns can be used to help people overcome inappropriate fears (e.g. fear of heights, post-traumatic stress disorder), to help children develop good behavior, or even to help yourself become what you want to be. After reading this chapter, use your creativity to apply these patterns!

p10.original: 行为心理学考察经历如何塑造我们的行为，包括我们习得的联结、习惯和恐惧等。
p10.en: Behavioural psychology explores how our behaviour shapes, including the connections, habits and fears that we learn.
